$comment: Guardrail wiring. Claude Code only reads hook and permission config from this file — a hook script in .claude/hooks/ that is not listed here never runs. See AGENTS.md.
$comment2: Approves the figma server from .mcp.json by name rather than using enableAllProjectMcpServers, so adding a server to .mcp.json is still a deliberate act. Without this, agents dev-loop.js spawns headlessly would see the server as 'pending approval' and silently run with no Figma tools.
